# dice-box-threejs (vendored, unmodified)

3D dice with Three.js and cannon-es physics.

- Source: https://github.com/3d-dice/dice-box-threejs (v0.0.12, commit 6945e00)
- Author: Frank Ali (3D Dice), based on Major's 3D Dice
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE` in this folder

The files here are copied as they are. They import `three` and `cannon-es`,
which are regular dependencies in the project's `package.json`
(three is pinned to 0.143.0, the version this library was written for).

It is used from `src/components/Dice3D.jsx`.
